comment: Parameters a theme sets and then paints over: the base layer reads a variable, the theme feeds it
a value, and a later declaration on the same selector paints the property again with something
else. The parameter stays published and setting it moves nothing.
Not listed here, by design: a declaration the theme paints over where the base layer spells a
literal (no parameter exists, painting over is the only way to theme it), and two declarations
that carry the same value (bytes, not behaviour).
UPDATE_OVERRIDDEN_BASELINE=1 pnpm test -- overridden-parameters   # after a reviewed change
